rv.q: The discussion always reverts to “how many ‘likes’ did you get?”
Despite three very talented actors, the foundation of Andrew Kramer's play never seems steady or grounded in reality.
While the trio of performers is excellent in their roles, even their charisma can’t save this script from purgatory.
“St. Sebastian” suffers from too much needless dialogue and is vastly overdone.

cn.t: Refracted Theatre's debut receives mixed reviews, with critics split on this ambitious play tackling gentrification and LGBTQ+ themes. While some praise its thought-provoking nature, others find it overly preachy and unfocused.
